statusMeaning.VALID: The file's shape passed every check and every cross-resource reference resolved.
statusMeaning.VALID_WITH_NOTES: The file's shape is valid. Some supporting resources were simply not sent: not broken, just absent. These notes are stored with the case and lower certainty; they never raise a risk signal.
statusMeaning.INVALID: The file cannot be screened. Fix the resources named below and resubmit. There is no partial screening.

issue.BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the accepted size limit.
issue.BUNDLE_UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE: This file type is not accepted; send a single JSON file.
issue.BUNDLE_DEPTH_EXCEEDED: The file's structure is nested too deeply.
issue.BUNDLE_MALFORMED_JSON: The file's contents are not valid JSON and could not be read at all.
issue.BUNDLE_SCHEMA_INVALID: A field does not match its expected shape: the data type is wrong, or a required field is absent.
issue.BUNDLE_UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_TYPE: This resource type falls outside the part of the schema the system documents.
issue.BUNDLE_DANGLING_REFERENCE: A reference points at a resource that was not sent. A reference that cannot be resolved is an evidence-integrity defect, not merely an empty field.
issue.BUNDLE_CIRCULAR_REFERENCE: Resources reference each other in a loop, so the evidence chain cannot be traced.
issue.BUNDLE_DUPLICATE_RESOURCE_ID: One resource identifier is used more than once, so a reference to it is ambiguous.
issue.BUNDLE_TOTAL_MISMATCH: The claim total does not equal the sum of its lines.
issue.fallback: The file was rejected by the shape check.

page.title: Ingest / Demo
page.lede: There is no configuration wizard. Once validation succeeds, there is one button: screen the claim.
page.checkFailed: The bundle could not be checked
page.footnote: Every piece of data on this screen is synthetic and generated by this project's own code. No real medical record has ever entered the system.

report.heading: Validation status
report.refusedClient: The file was refused in the browser and never sent to the service. No case was created.
report.refusedServer: The service refused this file before storing it. No case was created, and there is no partial screening.
report.refusedHint: This file cannot be screened. Fix what is named below and resubmit. There is no partial screening.
report.emptyBody: Choose a file or one of the sample cases on the left. The validation report will fill in here.
report.screenableHint: There is no configuration step. Screening uses the rules and engine version currently in force.
report.notScreenableHint: The file is “{{status}}”, so it cannot be screened. Fix the resources named below and resubmit. There is no partial screening.

samples.heading: OR USE A SAMPLE CASE
samples.unavailable: The sample case list could not be loaded. Uploading your own file still works.
samples.loadFailed: The sample file could not be loaded ({{status}}).

upload.hint: One structured data file per submission

limit.empty: This file is empty. There is no content to check.
limit.tooLarge: The file is {{size}}, over the {{limit}} limit. It was not sent.
limit.wrongType: This file type is not accepted. Send one {{extensions}} file.

banner.duplicateTitle: A bundle with an identical fingerprint has been screened before
banner.duplicateBody: Fingerprint <0>{{hash}}</0> has already produced a case. Screening it again does not create a second case; it updates the one that already exists.
banner.completenessBody: The file's shape is valid; some supporting resources were simply not sent. Their absence lowers certainty and points toward requesting more evidence — it does <1>not</1> raise the risk signal.
banner.evidenceRequestTitle: Continuing a request for more evidence
banner.evidenceRequestBody: You arrived from a case awaiting evidence. Ingest the new version of the file below; once re-screened, that case returns to screened with its reason history intact.
